title: Boli ro ro ke Maa Ali Asghar
body:
BOLI RO RO KE MAA ALI ASGHAR ASWS. AY MERE NEEM JAA'N ALI ASGHAR ASWS.
TUJHKO DHUNDU KAHAN ALI ASGHAR ASWS..*2
<<MINI>>
AY MERE NEEM JAA'N ALI ASGHAR ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
1. LAB PE BANO KE THA YAHI NAUHA.
GODH QAALI HUI MERE BETA.
KISKO DU LORIYA'N ALI ASGHAR ASWS..*2.
<<MINI>>
AY MERE NEEM JAA'N....
<<DIVIDER>>
2. DEKE RAAH E QUDA JJH. MEIN JAA'N APNI.
TUNE IZZAT BADHAAYI HAIN MERI.
TUJHPE QURBAA'N YEH MAA ALI ASGHAR ASWS..*2.
<<MINI>>
AY MERE NEEM JAA'N.....
<<DIVIDER>>
3. HAR GHADI YAAD TERI AATI HAIN.
TERI FURQAT MUJHE RULATI HAIN.
TUJHKO KO DHUNDU KAHAN ALI ASGHAR ASWS..*2.
<<MINI>>
AY MERE NEEM JAA'N....
<<DIVIDER>>
4. DEEN E ISLAAM KI BAQA KE LIYE.
AY MERE LAAL DE DIYA TUNE.
HASKE HAR IMTEHAA'N ALI ASGHAR ASWS..*2.
<<MINI>>
AY MERE NEEM JAA'N....
<<DIVIDER>>
5. AAG QAIMON MEIN HAAYE AISI LAGI.
MERE HUMRAAH TERE JHOOLE KI.
REH GAYI LAKDIYAA'N ALI ASGHAR ASWS..*2.
<<MINI>>
AY MERE NEEM JAA'N...
<<DIVIDER>>
6. TERE MARNE SE AY MERE DILBAR.
KIS TARHA SE KAHUN MERE SAR PAR.
GIR PADA AASMAA'N ALI ASGHAR ASWS..*2.
<<MINI>>
AY MERE NEEM JAA'N....
<<DIVIDER>>
7. BOLI SAHIL YEH BANO E DUKHIYA S.A.
JAA RAHA HAI UTHO MERE BETA.
AB WATAN KAARWAA'N ALI ASGHAR ASWS..*2.
<<MINI>>
AY MERE NEEM JAA'N ALI ASGHAR ASWS.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kalaam: JANAB ALAMDAR SAHIL SAHAB.
